# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting JCode or LNSFLIVE-operated infrastructure to
[lnsflive@gmail.com](mailto:lnsflive@gmail.com). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://jaimegonzalezjr.com/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
